items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Herschel Evans, Jo Jones, Page said, why don't you get Harry

ctx.x: *Rust's Jazz Records lists the following succession of trumpeters for the 1937-38 Basie band: Bobby Moore, Bobby Hicks, Karl Georne, and for a recording on February 16, 1938, Harry Edison. Phil Schaap believes Hicks is a pseudonym.

He had trouble with his teeth or something, you know. And he was a good trumpet player. He was a fantastic trumpet player, geemanetti, he could play. And when he took ill, Herschel -- we were all staying at the same rooming house, Herschel Evans, Jo Jones, Page said, why don't you get Harry, you know. And in fact, Lucky had fired me for Dizzy. He fired me for Dizzy Gillespie. And because --
Well, had you given him any trouble or --
